parts.html: The K-13 standard model is a beige minimalist kitchen: a straight row of cabinets along the wall and a separate island. The fronts are light and solid-colored.
Beige fronts are easy to pair with floors and walls: wood, light stone, and decorative plaster all work.

How the K-13 is arranged: the work surface, built-in appliances, and cabinets are along the wall, with the island set apart. You can cook at the island and talk to whoever is in the room at the same time.
The upper fronts are acrylic-faced MDF and the lower ones HPL-faced MDF, in the same color. HPL handles scratches and moisture well, and the lower row is what gets bumped most often.
Above the work zone are cabinets with FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms. The other fronts hang on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges, and the drawers are Muller Box Profi Line.
Upper cabinet fronts: Acrylic-faced MDF board
Lower cabinet fronts: HPL-faced MDF board
Drawer system: Muller Box Profi Line
We arrange the appliances and storage in the K-13 the way that suits you, based on your layout and where the water and electrical connections are.
